facts.value: First-year applicants must meet at least one of the following: Top 25% in your high school graduating class; 3.00 GPA in competency courses (4.00 = A); ACT score of 22 for Arizona residents (24 nonresidents); SAT Reasoning score of 1120 for Arizona residents (1180 nonresidents).

facts.value: You can still gain general admission to most online programs at ASU through Earned Admission by completing online courses with a 2.75 GPA or higher.
